{{Quote|What is my problem is getting into this bunker. We don't know much about the facility, but it's a bigger operation than anything we saw on Rori. I expect this time we'll face fortified structures with well-trained defenders.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]]|<ref name="TotC" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''mission''' was carried out by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sarkli]]'s [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During an [[Mission to Naboo (Storm commandos)|assault]] on a [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|RNSF]] station on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the storm commandos discovered information about a Rebel bunker on Corellia. The Imperial troops then attacked the bunker where they fought [[General/Legends|General]] [[Polo Se'lab]]'s [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] also joined the battle. The storm commandos eventually overcame their enemies, forcing the Rebel officers to flee.<ref name="TotC" />
